objectives.title: Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act (RESPA), 12 CFR Part 1024 (Regulation X)
Equal Credit Opportunity Act (ECOA), 12 CFR Part 1002 (Regulation B)
Truth in Lending Act (TILA), 12 CFR Part 1026 (Regulation Z)
Home Ownership and Equity Protection Act (HOEPA), high-cost mortgages (12 CFR 1026.32)
Higher-priced mortgage loans (12 CFR 1026.35)
MLO compensation (12 CFR 1026.36(d))
TILA-RESPA Integrated Disclosure Rule (TRID) (Know Before You Owe)
Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA), 12 CFR Part 1003 (Regulation C)
Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA)/Fair and Accurate Credit Transactions Act (FACTA) 15 USC 1681 et seq.
Federal Trade Commission Red Flag rules, 16 CFR Part 681
Bank Secrecy Act/Anti-money Laundering (BSA/AML)
Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act (GLBA) – Privacy, Federal Trade Commission Safeguard Rules and Do-Not-Call
Mortgage Acts and Practices – Advertising, 12 CFR Part 1014 (Regulation N)
Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act (E-Sign Act)
USA PATRIOT Act
Homeowners' Protection Act (Private Mortgage Insurance (PMI) Cancellation Act)
Dodd-Frank Act
Regulatory Authority: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB); Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)
SAFE Act and CSBS/AARMR Model State Law
State Mortgage Regulatory Agencies
License Law and Regulation
Licensee qualifications and application process
License maintenance (renewal, CE, inactive retake)
NMLS requirements including Temporary Authority to Originate
Compliance, prohibited acts, required conduct, penalties
Advertising: Requirement to include NMLS unique identifier in advertisements

Qualified and Non-qualified Mortgage Programs (conventional/conforming including Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac; government FHA, VA, USDA; conventional/nonconforming jumbo, Alt-A; subprime; nontraditional product risk guidance; non-qualified mortgage)
Mortgage Loan Products: fixed-rate, ARMs, purchase money second mortgages, balloon, reverse mortgages, HELOC, construction, interest-only
Terms Used in the Mortgage Industry (loan, disclosure, financial, and general terms)
Loan Inquiry and Application Process Requirements
Qualification: Processing and Underwriting (borrower analysis, qualifying ratios, ability to repay, appraisals, title report, insurance)
Closing (title and title insurance, settlement/closing agent, required closing documents, funding/rescission)
Financial Calculations (periodic interest, monthly payments, down payments, closing costs/prepaids, ARM adjustments)
Ethical Issues: prohibited acts (redlining, RESPA prohibitions, kickbacks/compensation)
Fairness in lending; fraud detection; advertising; unfair, deceptive, or abusive acts; predatory lending and steering

Ethical behavior related to loan origination activities; financial responsibility; mortgage company compliance; relationships with consumers; truth in marketing and advertising; general business ethics
